Completed the drift review in [the report](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-alpha-step1-drift.md:1). It contains all 15 A-page sections and one verdict per section.

Three pages are `drift-blocked` pending owner decisions:

- HH16 needs the RSK supplier page at order 1192; HH17 is affected through its HH16 dependencies. [Craven §1.5](https://web.mat.bham.ac.uk/D.A.Craven/docs/lectures/groupsgeomreptheory2013.pdf) gives the relevant insertion and reverse-deletion argument.
- HH18 needs the Type-A Hecke–Specht page at order 1569 for its quantum-action suppliers. [Davydov–Molev §4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/1008.3739v2) provides source context.

I made no plan changes; both additions require owner review because they expand prerequisite closure.

The required checks both exited 1. `drift-review-check --before-apply` reports the three owner-action blockers. `validate-plan` reports the two undeclared suppliers and a prerequisite cycle involving Soergel intersection forms, Kazhdan–Lusztig bases, and divided powers; it also emits 100 redundant-prerequisite warnings. The run remains at `1-drift`; the engine has not materialized a decision.
